name: @ax/teamda-cli
description: teamda command line client, builds its command tree from the public OpenAPI spec and calls the API with a scoped key
author: DOCORE

scripts.build: bun scripts/embed-spec.ts && bun build src/main.ts --compile --outfile dist/teamda
scripts.build:win: bun scripts/embed-spec.ts && bun build src/main.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64-baseline --outfile dist/teamda.exe
